notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.20 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're very excited to release the 1.20 patch! This one is [b]huge[/b]!

We've taken into consideration all of the feed back we've received over the past year and picked out the things we thought would make the Insanity's Blade experience even better along with the things we already planned on doing to improve the game!

Here is the giant list of changes:

[list]
[*]All new smooth single player camera
[*]Thurstan can now attack from ladders, vines, poles etc.
[*]Thurstan has faster attack speeds
[*]Attacks from the wall are much easier to pull off
[*]Speed through intro and outro text with punch/jump or just skip it with start!
[*]Fixed graphics on several levels (Church Stage platforms are now completed!)
[*]Icon for store daggers updated to show proper number (game originally had 6 but was cut to 5 and the icon wasn't changed :O)
[*]No more back tracking! When you go to receive a quest the game will automatically go to the stage you need to go to and skip the hidden wall sections completely
[*]Added the Plague Doctor enemy back into the Plague City stage
[*]Several enemy AI bugs fixed
[*]Grab issues for some enemies fixed (note that tree men are not meant to be picked up - some things really are too heavy for Thurstan!)
[*]Falling platforms in forest stage reprogrammed and are disabled for co-op
[*]Special Weapon and Quest Item pick up is now automatic when you walk over them
[*]Tighter analog stick response
[*]Grab animation plays when holding weapon now - grab distance increased as well
[*]Many other little things have changed here and there, like map font colors, the selection cursor for the map screen and the dialog box graphics
[/list]

*Please note that it is only the two of us play testing the game at this point, so if we've missed something in our playthroughs we apologize and will correct any reported bugs as soon as possible!

We hope you enjoy the improvements!!

-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games

**Also! The WGN edition is still on v1.19 right now while we finish some testing for it, v1.20 is expected within the following days ahead!

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.19 Update!
notes.notes:
Hi All!

One more tiny update here today! Thanks to more helpful feedback in your reviews Chris has tweaked a few parts of the game to improve your experience:

[list]
[*]Controls adjusted to better support Xbox One analog sticks (Xbox 360 controllers still work great too!)
[*]Added more color to some explosions
[*]Enemy explosions are switched to the pre-alpha style with the arcade-style blood
[*]Grab detection box is bigger, making it easier to grab without getting hurt!
[*]Enemy arm weapon animations are modified (check the how to play video for hints on getting this weapon!)
[*]Other minor tweaks that add polish to the game!
[/list]

Thanks again for all the feedback and for playing Insanity's Blade!

As always, please feel free let us know if there's any game breaking bugs and we'll be happy to take a look, but we also welcome you to [url=http://www.causalbitgames.com/2015/11/its-official-battle-princess-madelyn-is-a-go-happy-birthday-maddi/]check out our next title, Battle Princess Madelyn[/url]!

-Chris and Daven

Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.18 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello All!

We've just released the V1.18 patch which fixes a few bugs that might have occurred when starting a new game or playing ARCADE mode right after beating the game and returning the to title screen, and should be one of the last patches to Insanity's Blade unless any other game-breaking bugs might crop up.

[h1]This is also a good time for us to mention our next title:[/h1][b][url=http://www.causalbitgames.com/2015/11/its-official-battle-princess-madelyn-is-a-go-happy-birthday-maddi/]Battle Princess Madelyn[/url][/b]
which has a play-through video of the two stage prototype up on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Pzz-PpcX6c]YouTube[/url] already!

We've learned a lot in the process of developing, crowdfunding, releasing, and maintaining Insanity's Blade which will be reflected by this upcoming game.

We're also switching from the HTML5-based Construct 2 to Unity, which means Battle Princess Madelyn is coming to [url=http://www.causalbitgames.com/2015/11/battle-princess-madelyn-is-console-first-then-maybe-windows-etc/]consoles first[/url] as well as eventually releasing on Steam with much better performance through native export, and hopefully support for a greater range of hardware too!

But don't worry, we'll still be here to provide support in the discussion forums and patch up any game breaking bugs for some time to come!

Thank you all again for playing Insanity's Blade and for the great feedback we've received from you in the reviews and discussion posts along the way!

-Chris and Daven

Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.16 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

The latest build is now live featuring the following additions and bug fixes:

[list]
    [*][b]WINDOWED mode[/b]! This was much requested and is now tested and implemented after an engine update made it possible! Check out the OPTIONS menu at the title screen for configuring this option.
    [*]Added information to title screen to show the main differences between the more action-oriented ARCADE mode and the default STORY mode
    [*]Patched some gaps in levels where players reported being able to walk through walls and endlessly fall
   [*]Mages will now warp further from the player, to address some reports of them appearing over the player
   [*]Additions to stage 2 CAVE level to make it easier to spot possible traps!
   [*]Fixed an issue where the GAME OVER might not appear when losing all lives on harder difficulties
[/list]

As always, we thank you all for the continued support, bug reports, and feedback!

-Chris and Daven

Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.10 Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We're releasing a new update based on some of the excellent feedback in the discussions and reviews with the following changes so far:

[list]
[*]Enemies that rise from the ground will spawn further away from the player giving more time to react
[*]Fog effects are adjusted to improve the game performance
[*]Custom controller bindings have a small delay added to prevent skipping the JUMP control
[*]Fixed one sidequest that did not unlock properly in the stage replay mode (available by continuing from a save file that completed the story mode). Any and all missed side quests that would have permanent weapons should now be accessible until they are completed
[*]Modified the file and folder structure for greatly improved loading speed [b]Note: due to this change the update will be much larger than normal (roughly 500mb)[/b]
[/list]

[b]Update:[/b] We have heard that the patch may have trouble installing after the folder structure had changed and so it is recommended (if the update is stuck as paused) to uninstall and reinstall the game (your save files are still kept safe on your PC though!).

Anyone who installed the game after this update will not have that issue.

Thank you all for the positive feedback and we hope you continue to enjoy Insanity's Blade!
-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games Developers

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.09b Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! As of V1.09b we are happy to report that the final modifications to the shooter stage are live and should make the power-ups spawn more frequently!

We would also like to list a few of the bigger features that have been included in the game updates since its initial release thanks to all the feedback you've given us:

[list]
[*]New [b]ARCADE[/b] mode to accompany the STORY mode, a fast pace run through the whole game with no saves, just like the arcades of old!
[*]New [b]HELL[/b] difficulty for those seeking an even greater challenge!
[*]New [b]No Daggers[/b] options setting after beating the game which lets you fight with just your fists and weapons!
[*][b]CUSTOM CONTROLS[/b]! You can now map the keys and gamepad buttons how you like in the options* menu!
[/list]

Thank you all again for the absolutely amazing feedback and support along the way!

-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games 

*Note: Check the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/manual/334190]Readme[/url] for more information on setting up custom controls.

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.08 Update - Arcade Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are proud to present the latest addition to Insanity's Blade: An all new [b]ARCADE MODE[/b]! For those who want to slam through all of the main stages and bosses without the extra story and back tracking - [b]this is for you[/b]!

In this mode Weapons and Key Items are rewarded upon fighting bosses and completing full stages, and some sub-stages have been shortened while some of the tiny ones have been cut out all together to keep a fast pace. [b]Like a true arcade machine[/b], this mode has no saves! You can still pause or quit back to the title in-game whenever you need to though.

This mode also brings in some competition to the local couch co-op mode as you will get bonuses based on your performance at the end of each full stage!

None of this affects the original [b]STORY MODE[/b] which joins arcade mode as an option on the title screen now.

Thanks again to all of you who have given feedback, suggestions, and bug reports during the development of Insanity's Blade!

-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games
www.causalbitgames.com

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.07 Update!
notes.notes:
Today we've released another quick update which fixes a few bugs that snuck into the co-op mode since the last game engine update!

Based on your feedback we've also added a few tweaks to help new players get used to the game:
[list]
[*]The new game menu option now lets you choose a difficulty without going into options (aside from hell mode you can still change difficulty later in the options menu too!)
[*]Enemies on the first two stages have slightly lower HP to ease the difficulty curve in the beginning of the game
[*]The tree monsters no longer block and the skeleton king will block less frequently on the forest stage and side quest
[*]A helpful ghost will now teach you how to open their inventory when the first side quest is activated
[/list]

If you want to see some of the other changes in recent patches, you can also check out the changelog in the game manual on the Store page at: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/manual/334190]http://store.steampowered.com/manual/334190[/url] 

Thanks again to all of you for the continued support and suggestions!
-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.06 Update!
notes.notes:
To celebrate Valentine's Day this week Thurstan is bringing you [url=http://causalbitgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/800plove.jpg]SPECIAL LOVE AND KITTENS EXPLOSIONS[/url]!

Of course that's not all that's new! We've also added some more features:
[list]
[*]If you beat the game without all weapons unlocked, you can now [b]revisit those side-quests[/b] to complete them in the stage re-play mode!
[*][b]No Daggers mode[/b]! This mode can be unlocked in the options menu after beating the game and will let you turn on/off the ranged daggers attack [i](as requested by Solaire!)[/i]. Try this in combination with the [b]HELL MODE[/b] from the last update for an extreme challenge!
[*][b]New level cap[/b], now Thurstan can reach level 13!
[/list]

With the story mode of Insanity's Blade working how we (and hopefully you!) like now, we are looking forward to working on the additional content that was planned way back in the Kickstarter as well as a more "pure Arcade" mode.

These will keep us pretty busy, alongside the work we're doing on our future titles, and so it might be a few months before the next major update, but we'll still keep updating the game often if any bugs are reported!

Thank you all for the support so far,
-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games

Thank you all for the support so far,
-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.05 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're really glad to announce our next update which adds some much requested features:
 [list]
    [*][b]HELL MODE[/b] This is the toughest difficulty setting, and it can [b]only[/b] be selected when starting from a new game. You only start with one life and no continues, similar to Hard mode, but then there's a few extra things we've tweaked to make it tricky! [b]Warning! Once you start on HELL MODE you can't change the difficulty level for the save slot unless you overwrite it![/b]
    [*][b]CUSTOM CONTROLS[/b] In the options menu you'll now find a way to re-assign keyboard controls and gamepad buttons as well as a way to view and test them out! [i]The options menu and title screen will still use the default controls outlined in the manual.[/i]
    [*]Tweaked graphics on the Sunken Keep stage above the water/elevator ride
[/list]

Once again we thank you all for suggestions and glitch reports!

-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games

notes.title: Insanity's Blade V1.04 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We really thank you all for purchasing and playing Insanity's Blade so far and hope you're having fun!

We've just released the v1.04 build this week which has the following changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch in cutscenes and credits where the fade wouldn't reset
[*]Fixed a level skip glitch in the City stage
[*]Fixed a glitch where music would cut out during some cutscenes
[*]Fixed a glitch where the priestess cutscene might not trigger in 4:3 mode
[*]Easy difficulty - 60s extra time for most stages
[*]Normal difficulty - 30s extra time for most stages
[*]Stage timer fixed for Shooter stage boss
[*]Enemies no longer despawn on easy difficulty
[/list]

Regarding the level skip glitch, users who missed out playing the graveyard and church stages and have not yet completed the game can reset their save file to the city stage by pressing Shift + P at the start of the title screen. Normal save files will not be affected, but if a save file is found and fixed the SELECT SAVE screen will appear. This is optional though, as beating the game will let you replay all non-sidequest stages anyway.

Thanks again for your suggestions and glitch reports!

-Chris and Daven
Causal Bit Games
